remarks: Located in the desirable Hawthorne Condominium complex, this 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit offers a comfortable and convenient living space. The bright and airy layout features a kitchen with quartz countertops and newer stainless steel appliances. Adjacent to the kitchen is a versatile utility/laundry room (newer washer/dryer) that provides extra storage. The open floorplan seamlessly connects the living, dining areas and kitchen, creating a great space for daily living.  The bedroom is equipped with a generous closet, and the attached full bath includes a jetted tub/shower.   Enjoy the convenience of ample off-street parking for you and your guests. The unit has also been updated with a new HVAC system and hot water heater (2023). With low common charges, this home is a great value.  This property is part of the Mill River Land Trust, to which Owners have access, and is minutes from the quaint village of Glenville, where you'll find shops, restaurants, and parks. It is also conveniently located near major transportation routes and Westchester Airport.
